text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: detected multi-GPU collective stall on cluster-prod-4 (nccl_collective_hang). Auto-escalation -> paging oncall_maya. Severity: P1. Pod: inference-rendezvous-pt4-7f6c (node: gpu-07).
oncall_maya: I'm on it. pulling logs now.
eng_runtime_josh: tagging in — saw increased nvlink errors earlier, could be a driver/thermal repeat.
oncall_maya: quick status: `kubectl get pods -n inference inference-rendezvous-pt4-7f6c -o wide` shows pod in Running but ready=0/1. Node gpu-07 has high GPU memory usage.
ml_infra_raj: getting GPU health: `ssh gpu-07 sudo nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv` -> several TP workers pinned, memory ~98% on GPU0/1.
eng_runtime_josh: can you paste last 200 lines from container logs? `kubectl logs -n inference inference-rendezvous-pt4-7f6c --since=10m`
oncall_maya: logs show repeated NCCL timeouts and then `Xid 79` CUDA watchdog resets: "E NCCL Allreduce timed out" -> repeated.
support_ana: are customer jobs impacted? I'm seeing spikes in inference errors from AcmeCorp and BetaAI, increase in 5xxs for /v1/stream endpoint.
customer_ops_bob: AcmeCorp just filed a support ticket — some batch jobs failed and retried, customer-facing latency spiked ~2x for a few minutes. They want ETA.
eng_runtime_josh: immediate mitigation plan: 1) cordon gpu-07, 2) drain affected pods from node, 3) restart rendezvous pod to break stuck communicator, 4) route new requests to fallback single-gpu variant.
oncall_maya: executing: `kubectl cordon gpu-07` -> done. Starting drain (graceful) for non-critical pods.
ml_infra_raj: note: draining TP jobs may free up memory but check KV cache persistence. If we force delete the rendezvous pod we'll drop state; acceptable for P1 to restore service.
eng_runtime_josh: agree — force delete rendezvous pod `kubectl delete pod inference-rendezvous-pt4-7f6c -n inference --grace-period=0 --force` once drained. Also bump NCCL_TIMEOUT env to 180s on rollout to reduce flapping while we investigate.
oncall_maya: deleted pod, new pod scheduled on gpu-12 instead (autoscheduler moved it). New pod initializing.
support_ana: monitoring metrics: error rate falling but still ~0.5% above baseline. Notifying AcmeCorp with a brief incident update.
customer_ops_bob: told AcmeCorp ETA ~15m, they're okay but want root cause.
ml_infra_raj: gathering NVCrash + dmesg from gpu-07 before we recycle it: `sudo journalctl -k | tail -n 200` and `sudo cp /var/log/nvcrash/* /tmp/incident-5632109876/`
eng_runtime_josh: observed pattern: memory pressure -> NCCL allreduce timeouts -> Xid79 reset -> communicator doesn't recover -> hangs. Plausible contributors: slightly aggressive batch-size + small memory leak in recent tp4 optimizer rollout.
oncall_maya: rolling back recent tp4 optimizer image (deployed ~2h ago) to previous stable tag on a canary. Applying patch: `kubectl set image deploy/tp4-optimizer tp4-optimizer=repo/tp4-optimizer:v2026.02.11-stable`
eng_runtime_josh: also enabling temporary fallback routing rule in router: route requests for models/tp4/* to model-variant:single-gpu-smallbatch until we clear regression.
support_ana: sent message to affected customers: short summary + workaround (retry and expect transient failures); AcmeCorp acknowledged.
customer_ops_bob: capture: AcmeCorp job ids: 5591, 5592 failed, they retried and succeeded after 3 minutes. No data loss.
ml_infra_raj: uploaded logs and nvcrash artifacts to incident bucket s3://redwood-incidents/5632109876/ and triggered trace collection.
eng_runtime_josh: next steps: 1) postmortem once nvcrash and heap profiles are analyzed, 2) add guardrails to detect rising GPU memory across TP pipelines and auto-scale to smaller batch, 3) revert optimizer change if root cause confirmed.
oncall_maya: handing off to eng_runtime_josh for deep-dive and RCA. Oncall will follow up for customer comms.
incident-bot: Handoff recorded. Incident channel created: #incident-5632109876. Followup owners: eng_runtime_josh (RCA), ml_infra_raj (GPU logs), support_ana (customer comms). :white_check_mark:
